   ```python
   import numpy as np

   def project_h(h, target_sum):
       s = np.sum(h)
       diff = target_sum - s
       tolerance = 1e-6
       if abs(diff) < tolerance:
           return h
       # Interior adjustment
       h_clip = np.clip(h, tolerance, 1.0-tolerance)
       free_mask = (h > tolerance) & (h < 1.0-tolerance)
       if np.any(free_mask):
           h_adj = h[free_mask]
           h_final = np.copy(h)
           # Optimally distribute diff
           h_final[free_mask] = np.clip(
               h_adj + diff * np.exp(-10*abs(h_adj-np.mean(h_clip))),
               tolerance,
               1.0-tolerance
           )
           return h_final
       return h_clip
   ```
